cohort: Twenty-nine mother-child dyads were enrolled in central China.
finding: Maternal alcohol consumption during pregnancy significantly influenced the gut microbiota of both mothers and their newborns, showing differences between consumption and non-consumption groups and specific bacterial associations.
followup_time: Within 48 hours after birth (for infant samples)
cross-section timing: Maternal fecal samples were collected during late pregnancy, and newborn fecal samples were collected within 48 hours after birth.
